facts.other: NO separate 'Primeira Fase' existed. The 1996 Maratona was a single-site, single-stage event, run as 'The 1996 Programming Contest South America' (first South America regional; Regional Director Claudionor Coelho; only the champion qualified for WF 1997 San Jose). Two-phase format (first phase at many sites + Brazilian final) started only in 2004 ('Por vez primera en Brasil se realizan dos fases de competicion'). Catalogue entry should be marked as not a real contest; the 1996 event is the (South America regional) Maratona itself.
